meta.title: AGROGO — From farm to export, one platform
meta.description: Find cold storage, agricultural equipment, packing, transport and buyers for your harvest. Your agricultural logistics, connected through AGROGO.

hero.description: Your harvest’s next destination starts here. Find storage, equipment, packing, transport and buyers in one place.
hero.caption: Big opportunities. Rooted in the land.
hero.imageAlt: Farmland, a modern warehouse and a truck ready to transport the harvest at sunset

problem.title:
Harvest ready.
What comes next?
problem.description: Growing a great harvest is half the work. Storing, delivering and selling it should be simple, too.

items.title: Can’t find storage?
items.text: Your harvest can’t wait. But there’s no clear picture of available cold storage nearby.

items.title: Need equipment?
items.text: Is finding a tractor or harvester taking precious time at the height of the season?

items.title: Transport a challenge?
items.text: Need a carrier that can deliver on time and keep your produce at the right temperature?

items.title: Where are the buyers?
items.text: Your harvest is export-ready, but the route to a new market is still unclear?

steps.name: Farmer
steps.title: It all starts with you.
steps.text: Share your produce type, volume and location. Let’s connect the rest of the chain.

steps.name: AGROGO
steps.title: Every route, in one place.
steps.text: Explore storage, equipment, packing, transport and buyer offers that match your needs.

steps.name: Storage / equipment
steps.title: The right conditions for your harvest.
steps.text: Find storage and farm equipment in your region. Agree on the price and timing.

steps.name: Packing
steps.title: Produce, ready for market.
steps.text: Find sorting, grading and packing services to prepare your produce for buyers’ requirements.

steps.name: Transport
steps.title: One step closer to the buyer.
steps.text: Choose a carrier to match your cargo, volume and temperature requirements. Agree on delivery terms.

steps.name: Export
steps.title: A wider market for your harvest.
steps.text: Connect with local and international buyers. Agree on produce, volume and trade terms directly.
